The current introduction opens with ServiceRequest as an order, proposal, or plan for patient, group, device, and environmental-location services; retains the examples, CPOE/CDS/CarePlan, intent/results/basedOn, workflow, single-procedure, and multiple-ServiceRequest grouping guidance; and omits only the procedure-performer sentence that FHIR-50610 later removed.
